format_note: Matching is by content, not by line. Every `find` occurs exactly once in the pre-patch file AND zero times after its own replacement, so applying this map twice is a no-op rather than a duplication — verified mechanically, not asserted.

replacements.note: RenderIndex has no translator injected and is constructed by the container from extend.php, so resolve() is the cheapest correct form. The find deliberately runs on into the head of the NEXT docblock: inserting the two helpers between them destroys the matched span, so applying this map twice is a no-op instead of a fatal 'Cannot redeclare RenderIndex::t()'. Same reason every other entry here already survives a second pass.

Removes number_format(), which hardcodes the English 1,234 grouping: n() asks ICU for the locale's separator instead. The message is the NOUN only and the plural category is still chosen by ICU from {count} — English and Spanish both put the figure first, so nothing is lost by keeping the <b> outside the message.

esc() drops out because the two $meta closures below now return translated markup from t(), which has already escaped every value it interpolated. Escaping it a second time would print <b> on the page.

ONLY matches a tree where an earlier revision of this map already landed. That revision's n() delegated to an ICU `lib.number` key, which ICU formats with Flarum's locale code `es` — and generic `es` groups 12.431 while MEXICAN Spanish groups 12,431 (measured: es->12.431, es-MX->12,431, es-419->12,431, en->12,431). window.lmxI18n already maps es->es-MX on the client (looksmax-i18n/js/dist/forum.js:44), so the old form printed 12.431 in the server-rendered index next to 12,431 in the client-rendered search, on the same page. On a fresh tree this find does not exist, before or after the map is applied — verified mechanically at generation time.

Sibling case at line 135 (52 chars). Whoever owns less/forum.less should decide whether these become CSS truncation instead.

verification.how: Every claim below was produced by a script in /tmp/claude-0/-root/605d3ebe-a4f4-4fca-ac6b-09db76e73096/scratchpad and re-run after each edit; each check was also deliberately broken once to confirm it goes red.
checks: gate_search_index_analytics.py — en/es key parity, ICU placeholder parity, plural arms present on both sides, every key the map calls exists, no dead keys, php -l / node --check on every touched file.

icu/render.ts — every ICU string rendered at count 0/1/2/12431 in BOTH en and es-MX, through intl-messageformat (what PHP ext-intl agrees with) AND through RichMessageFormatter constructed exactly as Flarum builds it. The two must agree character for character. Also bans `#` inside a plural and markup inside a message.

icu/dom.ts — the APPLIED js/dist/forum.js loaded into happy-dom behind a real Flarum-shaped translator, palette driven, Spanish and English text asserted off the rendered DOM, and the DOM scanned for raw keys.
idempotency.py — every replacement is applied / pending / superseded against the live tree, and no entry can be applied twice.

keycheck.py — the SUPPLY side, which the i18n audit does not measure: every key the source actually calls must exist in both locales, including the ones built at runtime (AbstractBlock::headingKey, HeroBlock stats, NavBlock links, SectionsBlock view modes, OnboardingBlock steps, Sections::titleKey/descKey). A called-but-missing key renders as a raw key on the page under HTTP 200 with nothing in any log.
verification.php_intl: Dockerfile:19 installs ext-intl, so the real MessageFormatter is used and not symfony/polyfill-intl-messageformatter, whose own docblock says it implements plural rules for English only.

out_of_scope_defects.problem: Html::num() is `return number_format((float) $n);` — the English 1,234 grouping, hardwired. Every figure the new block front page prints goes through it: HeroBlock's three stat tiles, NavBlock's per-section counts, SectionsBlock's and BrowseBlock's thread counts.
out_of_scope_defects.impact: A Spanish reader sees an English-formatted number beside Spanish text on the front page, and a number formatted DIFFERENTLY from the one the search results on the next page show, because those go through window.lmxI18n.
out_of_scope_defects.fix: The same shape as the n() in this map's corrective entry: take resolve(TranslatorInterface::class)->getLocale(), map `es` -> `es-MX` (generic es groups 12.431, Mexican es groups 12,431 — measured), and format with \NumberFormatter, falling back to number_format() when ext-intl is absent. Not edited here: Html.php is outside this lane.

out_of_scope_defects.problem: `forum.news.*` (heading, empty, see_all, pinned, dismiss) is written but nothing reads it. NewsBlock reads `forum.index.news.*` — a different path, with a different key set (more, show, new_badge, by).
out_of_scope_defects.impact: None at runtime; five orphan keys. Flagged because they look like the news block's copy and are not, so the next person to edit 'the news strings' will edit the wrong ones.
out_of_scope_defects.fix: Delete them, or point NewsBlock at them. Left in place because they were written by another lane and deleting somebody else's keys mid-flight is worse than an orphan.

out_of_scope_defects.problem: extend.php:26 still mounts RenderIndex, while src/Blocks/* and src/Rails.php are a parallel, more complete front page. Both key sets are therefore live and both are carried in full in the locale files.
out_of_scope_defects.impact: 83 keys where roughly 60 would do. Nothing breaks.
out_of_scope_defects.fix: When RenderIndex is retired, the `forum.row/motd/card/list/stats/ad` block and `lib.number` can all go, and the corrective n() entry in this map with them. keycheck.py (see `verification`) prints exactly which keys are still reachable.
